artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Simon
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and brown ink, and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a classical setting. The composition features strong linear and crosshatch shading for depth and movement. The figures are depicted interacting in a dramatic manner with varied postures. One figure is reclining with twisted limbs, while another appears to be rising or gesturing emphatically. An ornate vase or urn is also present in the scene. The drawing style is reminiscent of the Old Masters, emphasizing anatomical detail and expressive poses.

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and brown ink, and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract and partially visible forms and sketches on paper. The drawing consists of faint pencil sketches and brown ink doodles exploring different subject matter and conceptual ideas. Some sketches echo figures or organic shapes with lines and unfinished forms. The composition shows various mark-making techniques, including shading and delicate line work. The paper's texture and aged appearance enhance the impression of an exploratory exercise, hinting at the artist's process and experimentation.

artworks.title: Bearded Man in Profile (recto) / Woman Looking Up (verso)
artworks.medium: graphite on blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile drawing of a man's head and neck. The man has a prominent nose, slightly open mouth, full beard, and curly hair. A hood loosely covers the back of his head, and the drawing is done in pencil on blue-gray paper with no other objects present.

artworks.title: A French Hussar Leading a Horse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink  over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing next to a horse. The man wears military attire with a sash, buttons, and a feathered hat. He has a mustache, boots, gloves, and a saber. He appears focused. The horse has decorative bridles. Trees are sketched in the background.

artworks.title: Woman Seated in a Bower
artworks.medium: watercolor with gum arabic over traces of graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The woman in the image is seated on a stone bench with lush foliage in the background. She has dark brown, wavy hair, a serene expression, and wears a white dress with lace details covered by a dark coat. She rests her head on her hand, eyes closed. A cushion with tassels is next to her.

artworks.title: The Temple of Minerva Medica
artworks.medium: watercolor with graphite on paper
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins, a partially standing brick structure covered with vegetation. Arched windows and decaying form are silhouetted against a sky with wispy clouds. The horizon is implied by the line where the earth meets the sky. The tones of the earth merge with the pastel blue sky. The brushstrokes are fluid, giving a sense of age and atmosphere. Rocky terrain with patches of grass and shrubs contrast with the ruins. Distant structures and trees are hinted at, all portrayed with a serene color palette and soft, misty outlines.

artworks.title: Rustic Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from an elevated point of view. The horizon is low, partly obscured by a cluster of trees and a country house. The brushstrokes are detailed, showing the wooden house and foliage. The sky features soft, flowing clouds in cream and light blue. The color palette includes earthy browns, greens, and blues. A figure tends to farm work near a fence, and another figure in a red bonnet stands along a dirt path. In the distance, figures walk towards a well in this serene rural depiction.

artworks.title: Two Men in Oriental Dress
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The pencil drawing features two seated individuals shown from the waist up. The person on the left is leaning forward with one elbow on their knee and their hand under their chin, looking towards the person on the right. The person on the right has a full beard and their head tilted slightly to the left. Both individuals wear turbans and are dressed in layered clothing. The background is minimal, and there are no visible objects held by the figures, except for the sword-like object held by the person on the left.

artworks.title: A French Hussar
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person sitting. The person is sketched in a relaxed, upright seated position. The facial features are softly drawn, with a subtle expression. The person's hair is styled underneath a tall hat with a small emblem. They are wearing a detailed military-style jacket with cords or braiding, and a sash draped over the shoulder. The person is holding an object. The background is plain, with a simple sketch of another figure or object on the right side. There is an artist's signature at the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: French Officer
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping and white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing confidently in a full-body portrait. He is depicted in a three-quarter view, with his facial features including a mustache and neatly combed hair. The man is dressed in a military-style uniform with a double-breasted jacket, epaulettes on the shoulders, and high collar. His light-colored trousers are tucked into his shoes. He holds a hat under his left arm and a sword with his right hand, with its scabbard hanging by his side. The background features textured brushwork hinting at a natural outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Arab Market
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.description: This is a painting of an outdoor scene with two figures in front of a traditional Middle Eastern or North African architectural setting. The scene shows a shaded archway where one figure, seated and wearing traditional attire, appears to engage with another figure who is standing. The standing figure is clad in garments typical of regions influenced by Ottoman or Mediterranean styles. The setting includes earthy tones with hints of blue sky above and greenery spilling over a wall. Various objects and merchandise are visible around the seated figure. This painting is in the style of John Frederick Lewis, known for his detailed depictions of Orientalist themes.

artworks.title: Interior with Dancer
artworks.medium: graphite, squared for transfer, on buff wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a room with multiple figures sitting or standing. The central figure is mid-step in a dance, with long flowing hair and a loose-fitting garment. Surrounding them are other figures in Middle Eastern attire, some holding musical instruments. The room has simple wall decorations and a chandelier overhead. The figures are arranged around the central space, with a focus on the dancer.

artworks.title: Vue de Ruines, à Tindare
artworks.artist: Thales Fielding after Comte de Forbin
artworks.medium: color aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view through the ruins of an ancient stone archway. The viewer looks through the archway along a path strewn with large blocks of stone and vegetation. The horizon is not distinctly visible due to elements cluttering the scene. The sky dominates the upper third of the image. The brushstrokes are refined, depicting detailed textures of the stone ruins and foliage. The color palette includes earthy tones, with warm browns, beiges, vibrant greens, and soft blue and pink in the sky. A solitary figure is present amidst the rubble.

artworks.title: Boissy d'Anglas présidant la Convention le 1er Prairial An III
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crowded hall or theater filled with motion and tension. Various people are depicted in dramatic poses within a grand, dimly-lit interior space with draped ceilings. Some figures hold weapons or point, adding to the chaos. The scene suggests an upheaval inside what appears to be an assembly hall, with galleries above filled with onlookers. The detailed figures convey a sense of energy and intensity within the crowded space.

artworks.title: Battle of Naked Men
artworks.artist: Andrea Mantegna or School after Antonio del Pollaiuolo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: Illustration for "Jestrab Kontra Hrdlicka, XXII" (Girl asleep on a bed)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor on board
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a young woman lying on her back on a bed. She is comfortably positioned, with her right arm extended over her head and her left arm resting by her side. Her face is slightly tilted upwards, with closed lips and eyes shut. Her dark hair is styled up, with some loose strands. She wears a light-colored, sleeveless dress with lace detailing. A pillow supports her head, and there is a decorative curtain in the foreground. A vase with flowers is placed near her, and the background is monochromatic, emphasizing her serene posture.

artworks.title: Standing Nude Woman Holding a Box
artworks.medium: graphite on paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: This drawing is a full-body sketch of a woman standing, one leg slightly bent. She is shown in profile, her head facing to the left and her eyes looking upwards. She has high cheekbones, a long nose, and a sharp jaw. Her long hair is tied behind her neck, with some short, curly bangs over her forehead. She is nude. In both hands, she holds a small, rectangular object near her hip on the right. The background is blank, off-white paper, and on the right is a detailed sketch of her hand holding the corner of the rectangular object.

artworks.title: Standing Saint holding the Christ Child
artworks.medium: graphite on paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image portrays a person holding a child. The adult is standing and turned towards the right with their head tilted slightly upwards. Both figures have halos above their heads. The adult is wearing a long robe and a cross around their waist, while holding a flowering branch in their left hand. The child is cradled in the adult's right arm, facing slightly forward and to the left. The background is a simple, vertical rectangular frame with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Zeus and Hera
artworks.medium: chalk, charcoal and graphite on heavy paper mounted to canvas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection

artworks.title: Botanical-Milt
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a botanical illustration of a plant with a long green stem, pointed green leaves, and small budding flowers at the top. The color palette is muted, featuring light greens and browns against a soft beige background. The plant is positioned centrally, with its leaves extending outward and its flowers reaching upward, occupying most of the image's vertical space.

artworks.title: Botanical Sketch
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image displays two botanical illustrations with handwritten annotations and sketches of plants. The plant on the left has red flowers and green leaves. On the right, there is a simple colored sketch of a grass-like plant with slender green leaves. The color scheme includes earthy greens and soft reds on a cream background. The left side showcases the colored illustration of the flowering plant at the top, while the right side features the tall sketch of the grass-like plant. Additional pencil sketches and notes are also present around the main illustrations.

artworks.title: Thistle
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a thistle plant with spiked leaves and a fluffy bloom at the top. The drawing is in shades of grey, creating a monochrome sketch. The thistle is centered and slightly to the right, with the flower head at the top and the curved stem extending downward with jagged leaves. The background is plain and textureless, emphasizing the details of the thistle.

artworks.title: Ornamental design with two birds pecking at fruit
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and brown ink and graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Anne and Jacques Baruch Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two blue birds surrounded by pink and white flowers with green leaves, set against a detailed, patterned background. The color palette includes beige, blue, pink, white, and green tones. The birds are at the bottom center of the image, surrounded by flowers and leaves, while the detailed pattern fills the upper part of the image.

artworks.title: Ornamental Design with Birds and Lily
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Anne Baruch in honor of Mrs. Ellen Nickel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental scene with floral elements and birds. The drawing features lush floral patterns behind a putto-like figure seated on a decorated ledge, reaching towards a group of birds. The background includes swirling leaves and blossoms, while the architecture exhibits decorative motifs enhancing the classical aesthetics of the piece.
